# CircusMaillardiFunctions

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

CircusMaillardiFunctions harbours some home-made functions used for analyses in the manuscript 'Long-term population monitoring reveals an alarming decline in the endangered endemic Réunion Harrier *Circus maillardi*' https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.11.07.687144v2 

## Installation

You can install the development version of CircusMaillardiFunctions like so:

``` r
require(devtools)
devtools::install_github("avillersofb/CircusMaillardiFunctions")

```
